info.name: PRAXIS API
info.description:
Complete PRAXIS backend: 63 HTTP endpoints across 9 routers, plus 1 WebSocket.

SETUP
1. Set {{base_url}} (default http://localhost:8000), {{email}} and {{password}}.
2. Run '01 Authentication > Login' first — it captures {{access_token}} and {{user_id}}.
3. Requests that need an id (job, roadmap, goal, ...) read collection variables that
   earlier requests populate automatically via their test scripts.

CONVENTIONS
- Collection routes have NO trailing slash (/api/goals). The exception is
  /api/cover-letter/, which is the opposite way round.
- A missing token returns 401, not 403.
- The Applications folder takes NO Authorization header at all.

Requests touching a known defect name the bug id in their description.
See BUG_REPORT.md and ENDPOINT_TESTS.md.

item.name: 08 · Notifications

request.description: BUG NOTIF-01: unbounded — no limit, offset, or cursor. Returns every notification ever received.
Returns {"marked_read": n}. BUG NOTIF-02: no response_model, so the shape is undocumented.

item.description:
WebSocket (not representable in this collection): ws://localhost:8000/ws/notifications?token={{access_token}}

Mounted at the ROOT, not under /api. On connect the server pushes every unread notification as individual JSON frames.

BUG NOTIF-03: the token travels in the query string, so it lands in access logs and browser history.
BUG NOTIF-04: the unread flush uses `except: break`, so one failing row silently drops every later notification.

request.description: Tones: professional | enthusiastic | concise. An unknown tone silently falls back to professional but is stored as sent.
NOTE the trailing slash — this router registers '/' while every other registers '', so it behaves the opposite way (BUG GOALS-07).
id is a plain str, not UUID — an arbitrary string gives 404, not 422.
